properties.title: ALTRINA

overview_description.description: Altrina develops enterprise software that uses autonomous AI agents to automate complex, multi-step workflows and standard operating procedures in regulated industries. The company focuses on back-office operations such as claims processing, prior authorizations, contract review, legal filings, and support ticket handling. Its platform connects via APIs and autonomous browser access to thousands of enterprise systems, including healthcare, legal, and financial applications. Altrina allows operations, finance, legal, and healthcare teams to define workflows in plain language and run them at scale across fragmented technology stacks. The software records each agent action for auditability and is designed to operate within existing legal, compliance, and security controls. It targets organizations seeking to reduce manual workload while maintaining strict regulatory and data protection requirements.
